response.original_title: [Add-Passenger] How do I add a Passenger to my Norwegian Cruise
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL) booking 1-866-254-7549, you must call Norwegian Customer Service directly 1-866-254-7549 or contact your travel agent 1-866-254-7549, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app.How to Process the Addition Call Norwegian Directly: If you booked your cruise straight through the cruise line, call their customer support. In the US and Canada, you can call 1-866-254-7549; in the UK, call +44-120-420-8151. Contact Your Travel Advisor: If you used a third-party travel agent 1-866-254-7549 or agency, you cannot change it yourself through NCL; your travel agent must handle the modification on your behalf 1-866-254-7549.Important Rules & Requirements Stateroom Capacity: Your current cabin must have a physical extra berth available (such as a sofa bed, 3rd/4th berth, or Pullman setup). If your room is at maximum capacity 1-866-254-7549, you may need to upgrade to a larger stateroom or book a separate cabin.
